create_google_generate_content: create a Google GenAI content generation request using the generateContent endpoint with model name and generation config
create_google_stream_generate_content: create a Google GenAI streaming content generation request using the streamGenerateContent endpoint with SSE response
test_google_count_tokens: test the Google GenAI token counting endpoint that translates contents to messages and returns total token details
create_google_interaction: create a Google GenAI interaction using the interactions endpoint with model or agent parameter
get_google_interaction: get a Google GenAI interaction by its ID from the interactions endpoint
delete_google_interaction: delete a Google GenAI interaction by its ID from the interactions endpoint
cancel_google_interaction: cancel a running Google GenAI interaction by its ID from the interactions endpoint
